source.text:
> In a fully mechanized/automated world, we won't work. It will make no sense to work.

Your entire argument rests of this statement. Why wouldn't it make sense to work? How would one company differentiate its products from another if they're all using the same AI?

Let's take a contrived example. Let's say automation can produce yachts for all of us at affordable prices someday. We're just going to all own yachts then. What will be the reason for one person to choose one yacht over another? Branding, marketing, positioning, patents, regulations, etc. Who does that work? Humans. Because ultimately you're selling to humans in a human-controlled world, not machines.
